digest.component_or_area: module-size gate enforcement and file splitting
propositions: Six uncovered files in src/rebar sit at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap, blocking any future edits including comments
The module-size gate in CI fails with no allowlist; the cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt is locked and cannot be raised
Files must be split along logical architectural boundaries and call-graph seams, not mechanically to meet a number; resulting files must be 100-500 LOC with real headroom (not 1–2 lines)
Behaviour-preserving splits require unmodified test passes, navigation tool verification (Serena + grep), and stale registry/budget updates to avoid cascading failures
config.py was added to scope at 799 LOC after in-flight work landed it at the cap; _config_sources.py at 791 LOC is now uncovered after its owner closed
Census is stale after 45 recent merges including ~300-line new module and additions to six files; next session must re-run census before selecting targets
